description: This file defines utility functions for constructing standardized JSON API responses with theming support, including success and error responses, based on a predefined theme configuration.

methods.name: themed_payload(status: str, message: str, data=None, meta=None)
methods.description: Builds a standardized themed response payload with status, message, data, and meta fields, incorporating a predefined theme.

methods.name: success(message: str, data=None, meta=None, status_code: int = 200)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a standardized JSON success response with optional data and metadata.

methods.name: error(message: str, status_code: int = 400, errors=None, meta=None)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a standardized JSON error response with optional errors and metadata.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^def error(message: str, status_code: int = 400, errors=None, meta=None):$/

ctags.name: success
ctags.pattern: /^def success(message: str, data=None, meta=None, status_code: int = 200):$/

ctags.name: themed_payload
ctags.pattern: /^def themed_payload(status: str, message: str, data=None, meta=None):$/
